entities.title: Unit tests and the branch-coverage gate
entities.summary: All zazzled tests run with `cargo test -p zazzled`, the zazz tests against a release zazz-worker; coverage.sh fails unless branch coverage of non-test code reaches a threshold, 95 in CI, for zazzled and for each zazz crate.
criteria: Every unit test in the crate passes.
Branch coverage of the crate, test code excluded, is at least the given percentage (95 by default); CI holds zazz-format, zazz-sdk and zazz-worker to the same 95 with the same script.

checks.description: Runs every unit test; CI runs it on macOS and Linux, and the release runs it again on Linux. The zazz tests build real scripts, so they need the wasm32-wasip1 target, and use the release zazz-worker, which testutil::worker_bin builds with cargo on first use.

checks.symbol: zazz tests one at a time (macOS, 15 minute limit)
checks.description: On macOS CI first runs the zazz:: tests on one thread under a hard time limit, so a test that hangs under the macOS sandbox shows up by name.

checks.command: sh zazzled/coverage.sh 95 [CRATE] (in macos/rust; nightly toolchain with cargo-llvm-cov)
checks.description: Reads the branch percentage of CRATE (zazzled by default) from cargo llvm-cov's JSON summary and fails below the threshold. Test modules are marked coverage(off).
CI's coverage job runs coverage.sh with 95.
The same job runs coverage.sh 95 for zazz-format, zazz-sdk and zazz-worker.
